name: LangChain
shortDescription: Open-source libraries for agents, chains, and tool calling, plus optional LangSmith traces.
longDescription: LangChain is a set of libraries for composing agent and tool-calling workflows. LangSmith, the tracing product on the same site, is separate, and its pricing page lists a $0 developer plan and a paid Plus plan.
freeTierNotes: Up to 5,000 base traces per month, then pay as you go.
bestFor: Developers composing agent workflows in code
Teams that want run traces via LangSmith
notIdealFor: People who want only a visual builder
strength: LangChain 1.4.6 includes composing tool-calling workflows in code.
weakness: LangSmith's developer plan includes 5,000 base traces per month before usage billing, and Plus is $39 per seat per month.

handsOn.detail: We installed version 1.4.6 and confirmed it loads. We did not sign up, pay, or run it on a real task.

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Open-source library for agents that call tools in code you write.
